recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male musician performing live, playing an acoustic guitar and singing into a microphone. The background features deep blue stage lighting with blurred bokeh elements, while the subject is illuminated by warm spotlights. Typography is flush-right in the upper corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's head and microphone in the upper left quadrant
Guitar body spanning the lower horizontal third
Text block anchored to the top right corner
Microphone stand creating a diagonal line through the center
coreInvariants: Warm skin tones and wood grain against a cool blue background
Shallow depth of field blurring the stage equipment
Subject wearing a plaid shirt and dark vest

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician is the primary subject, scaled to fill approximately 70% of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The musician's face and the microphone are the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the face, follows the microphone stand down to the guitar, and then moves up to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right corner provides a dark, relatively clean area for legibility of the title text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and navy blue background for atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm yellow and tan of the acoustic guitar and skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red outlines on the secondary text for visibility.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value on the subject's face and guitar; low value, high saturation in the background shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to a primary blue/yellow/red triad

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same-family variation using color and case to differentiate hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and aggressive slant of the primary text.
Provides the clean, modern sans-serif look required.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a male musician with grey hair in a plaid shirt and vest, playing an acoustic guitar on a stage with blue lighting and a microphone in front of him. Ensure the top right corner is dark and out of focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in bold white italicized sans-serif in the top right, and the album title in red with a white outline directly below it, both right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the musician's face clearly visible?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for the subtitle
mustRedesign: Any specific venue logos or microphone brand names
The 'WSM' logo on the stand in the foreground

mustAchieve: Clear legibility of text against the background
avoid: Cluttered backgrounds that obscure the text

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility in the upper right.
Ensure the guitar looks like a standard acoustic model.
Verify the microphone does not obscure the musician's eyes.
Confirm the color palette is limited to blue, white, red, and wood tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Stage photography + right-aligned bold sans-serif typography + cool/warm color contrast.
